description:
MOVEHOME ESTATE AGENTS ... are honoured to offer an exquisite 5 bedroom 3 bathroom semi-detached period property which spans to an impressive 186 m² / 2,002 ft² on two levels with one of the most beautiful private gardens in Drumcondra. From the moment you approach the large drive, this beautiful period home makes an immediate impression, with its attractive red-brick façade, distinctive period detailing, bay windows and beautiful front garden with an array of mature plants. Number 22 is an exceptional home of distinction, which combines enormous character with the classic style and all the comforts and conveniences one could wish for. This is one of those special family homes that rarely comes to the market, offering an abundance of character, generous living space and superb private gardens, all perfectly positioned on one of Drumcondra’s most established residential roads. The much anticipated release of this property to the market, after over 50 years being with the same family, represents a rare and genuine opportunity to purchase a substantial 5 bedroom dream home that requires modernisation, yet gives the new owners a fantastic opportunity.

The accommodation comprises of a large welcoming hallway which retains its original stained-glass hall door and beautiful period ceiling coving, with a large cloakroom conveniently located off the hall. There are two generously proportioned interconnecting reception rooms, the living room to the front has a beautiful part tiled fireplace as the main focal point with a bay window flooding the room with light throughout the day and enjoying a westerly orientation. Discreet sliding double doors lead to the family room also with an impressive original fireplace, high ceilings and ceiling to floor glass doors that lead to the private rear garden. A large kitchen and breakfast room overlooks the wonderful rear garden also, with an original fireplace and seating area. The kitchen is complemented by a useful utility room to the side, with access to the large garage and rear access to the WC and amazing garden.

On the first floor there are five generous double sized bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with an en-suite, providing fantastic accommodation for a growing family. The bedrooms are well proportioned the main master with a bay window and they offer excellent versatility, while the overall layout provides plenty of scope for a new owner to modernise and personalise the property to their own taste. A fully tiled bathroom suite with two windows, bath, walk in shower and bidet completes this level and attic access is enjoyed from the generous landing. The attic is currently used for storage and can be easily converted to another bedroom, playroom or domestic office.

The gardens are a particular feature in this extended period home. Private and exceptionally well established, the garden is predominantly laid in lawn and surrounded by mature hedging, colourful planting, established trees and beautiful borders. A peaceful and private haven is located at the very rear of the garden and that enjoys all day sunshine and evening sunset. This it offers an exceptional outdoor space for family life, entertaining or simply enjoying the sunshine. The easterly orientation ensures plenty of sunshine and the gardens are very private.

The location of 22 Calderwood Road offers the perfect balance of peace and convenience. Set in a leafy residential neighbourhood just off Griffith Avenue, the property is within easy reach of local shops, cafés, restaurants and excellent public transport links to Dublin city centre. A selection of schools, including Maryfield College, Dominican College and Ardscoil Rís, are nearby, while Croke Park, Westwood Gym, the Regency Leisure Centre, Clontarf Golf Club and St Vincent's GAA are all within easy reach. The property is also ideally positioned for commuters, with numerous bus routes serving the area and convenient access to the M1 and M50. A superb family location combining tranquillity, convenience and excellent connectivity.

Early viewing is essential to appreciate all this wonderful period home has to offer and by appointment with MOVEHOME Estate Agents ... 01-88 44 690

features: * Magnificent early 1940s 5 bedroom 3 bathroom period family home spanning approx. 186 m² / 2,002 ft² on two levels
* Wonderful interconnecting formal living rooms with peaceful views of the gardens and feature fireplaces
* 5 spacious double bedrooms with Master bedroom ensuite
* Large garage and utility room, with WC to the side with access to the rear garden
* Many original period features including 3m high ceilings, stained glass and covings throughout
* Easterly orientation 150ft private rear landscaped garden with an abundance of mature trees and shrubbery
* Ample off street parking for 3/4 vehicles
* Beside all local amenities such as established Primary and Secondary schools
* Minutes from the M50, M1 and Dublin Airport
